headline: Lima Transport Prices Rise 15.75% Annually Due to Fuel and Fare Hikes
summary: Consumer transport costs in Lima increased by 15.75% over the 12-month period to October, driven by higher fuel prices and rising land and air travel fares.
why: Urban transport inflation directly impacts household budgets and core consumer price indices monitored by central banks.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Higher transport inflation adds upward pressure to headline consumer price growth in Peru.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
